verdict.rationale: Drata documents a public APIv2 with OAuth and broad CRUD endpoints (controls, evidence, monitoring tests, custom connections), so compliance work can run programmatically without the UI. That is a headless automation surface, but nothing documents a CLI, CI integration, or pipeline usage, and the OpenAPI spec was not retrievable by probe. missing for 10: official CLI or CI/pipeline integration (e.g., a GitHub Action), documented headless/CI usage guides, machine-fetchable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
